court: United States District Court, District of Minnesota
caption: United States of America v. Hassan Ahmed Hussein and Ahmed Abdirashid Mohamed
short_caption: United States v. Hussein, et al.

ocr_corrections.issue: Tesseract read caption statute as 18 U.S.C. § 1348. Visual inspection of the scan and the count-closing line on p.7 both show 18 U.S.C. § 1343 (wire fraud). 1348 is securities fraud and is not charged.
Handwritten assignment OCR'd as 'CR US-479 PIS/ECW'. Visual: CR 25-479 PJS/ECW.
Paragraph 24 OCR'd as 'Onor about'. Visual: 'On or about'.
Count-table OCR dropped the numeral 1 on the April 27, 2023 row. Visual inspection of the table shows Count 1, Email from HASSAN HUSSEIN to AllCare Software.
CM/ECF header fragments and missing spaces (1of8, 6of8, 8of8). Count emails, dates, and $750,000 figures were checked against the page images.

defendants_caption.name: Hassan Ahmed Hussein
defendants_caption.role_on_face: Co-owner/operator of Pristine Health LLC; alleged HSS Program Coordinator; registered Pristine with MN SOS on or about January 10, 2022 and completed DHS HSS enrollment with Mohamed.

defendants_caption.name: Ahmed Abdirashid Mohamed
defendants_caption.role_on_face: Co-owner/operator of Pristine Health LLC; alleged HSS Program Coordinator; registered Pristine with MN SOS on or about January 10, 2022 and completed DHS HSS enrollment with Hussein.

providers.name: Pristine Health LLC
providers.role_on_face: HSS provider registered with MN SOS on or about January 10, 2022 by Hussein and Mohamed; enrolled as HSS provider the same time. Alleged office suite in St. Paul. Both defendants styled as HSS Program Coordinators.

related_providers_recital_not_charged_he.name: Foundation First
related_providers_recital_not_charged_he.notes: Para 18 recites that Hussein and Mohamed worked with Foundation First, alleged to generate fake HSS paperwork, to fabricate Housing Focused Plans for Pristine beneficiaries. Recital of a co-provider already charged in Aden 0:25-cr-00349; this indictment does not charge Foundation First operators and its dollars are not added here.

related_providers_recital_not_charged_he.name: Brilliant Minds Services LLC
related_providers_recital_not_charged_he.notes: Para 19 recites that Company 1 marketed beneficiary-finding services to Pristine and to Brilliant Minds. Recital, not a charge against Aden defendants. Do not add Pristine $750k to Brilliant Minds $2.3M.

scheme_period.notes: Para 14 scheme window January 2022 through June 2025. Para 13 claims window is January 2022 through April 2025.

counts_closing_quote: All in violation of Title 18, United States Code, Section 1343.

forfeiture.notes: If convicted of any of Counts 1-5, forfeiture of proceeds-traceable property; substitute-asset allegation under § 853(p). No dollar amount is stated in the forfeiture paragraphs.

amounts.quote: In all, between approximately January 2022 and April 2025, Pristine Health submitted approximately $750,000 in fraudulent Medicaid claims related to the Housing Stabilization Services program.
amounts.notes: Face language is submitted fraudulent Medicaid claims. Charging allegation, not amount_paid and not proven_loss. Same ~$750k restated as claimed-entitled in para 21; do not sum para 13 + para 21. Do not add to first-wave HSS (Aden/Falade/Anwar/Asad) or to FOF.

amounts.quote: Ultimately, the defendants claimed to service nearly 100 different beneficiaries through Pristine and for such services claimed to be entitled to about $750,000.
amounts.notes: Same Pristine ~$750k as para 13; do not sum. Also alleges nearly 100 purported beneficiaries. Not a Falade/Aden/Adow figure. Not FOF.

program_rate_recitals_not_case_totals.quote: Consultants could bill Medicaid about $174 for a consulting session.
program_rate_recitals_not_case_totals.notes: Statewide HSS rate recital, not a Pristine total.

program_rate_recitals_not_case_totals.quote: Providers can bill about $68 per hour of transition services provided.
Moving expenses of up to $3,000, subject to conditions.
Before the Program’s inaugural year, DHS predicted the Program would cost about $2.6 million annually.
program_rate_recitals_not_case_totals.notes: DHS prediction recital, not this case.

statewide_hss_program_payouts_recital.quote: In 2021 alone, the Program paid out more than $21 million in claims. That figure ballooned in the following years: $42 million in 2022, $74 million in 2023, $104 million in 2024. In just the first six months of 2025, the Program paid out another $61 million.
statewide_hss_program_payouts_recital.notes: Statewide HSS program_spend recitals, not Hussein alleged_loss. Identical boilerplate also appears in Aden/Falade/Sallah. Already claimed; do not invent a second program-spend claim. Do not add these to Pristine $750k, first-wave HSS, or FOF $250M.

other_face_facts: Para 1: scheme to defraud federally funded health care benefits in Minnesota's Housing Stability Services Program; alleged misappropriation of millions of dollars in program funds (qualitative, no case-specific dollar; do not treat as a second Pristine total).
Face stamp: SCANNED DEC 16 2025 U.S. DISTRICT COURT MPLS.
Para 10-11: Hussein and Mohamed owned and operated Pristine Health LLC; registered with MN SOS on or about January 10, 2022 and completed DHS HSS-provider enrollment at the same time.
Para 16: purported to service individuals from an office suite in St. Paul.
Para 17: both styled as HSS Program Coordinators.
Para 18: Foundation First consultation/fabrication recital; not a charge against Aden defendants.
Para 19: Company 1 (unnamed) retained to find new beneficiaries; marketed to Pristine and Brilliant Minds; script for recruiting beneficiaries; subscription for monthly client lists.
Para 20: contracted with two software companies to submit Pristine HSS claims; Count 1 and Count 3 name AllCare Software.
Para 22: operations 'provided only a fraction of their claimed total.'
Para 23: proceeds shared with conspirators including Pristine employees; personal travel to London, Sydney, Dubai, Istanbul, and several destinations in Saudi Arabia. No dollar on the travel.
Page 8 is signature page (A TRUE BILL / UNITED STATES ATTORNEY / FOREPERSON); no additional counts.
related_to_asad_adow: Named in 0:25-cr-00354 ECF 17 reassignment of related case 25-479 PJS/ECW to Judge Blackwell. Not a charging instrument against Asad Adow.
do_not: Do not sum overlapping dollars (para 13 $750k submitted claims + para 21 $750k claimed-entitled + statewide program payouts + qualitative 'millions').
Do not add Pristine $750k to first-wave HSS (Aden Brilliant Minds $2.3M / Foundation First $222k, Falade Faladcare $2.2M, Anwar Liberty Plus $1.2M, Asad Leo $2.7M) or to FOF $250M.
Do not treat $ figures in this indictment as proven_loss.
Do not invent a second statewide HSS program_spend claim; overlap_group already claimed.
